correctness.rationale: At p=137/100 the exact rational interval certificate computes all six reversal-orbit Schoenberg Grams. All eight LDL pivots are certified positive for (2,1,3); for each other orbit one certifiably negative pivot follows strictly positive predecessors. The integer-power inequalities rigorously enclose all 2^p, 3^p, and 4^p values. The zero-sum quadratic identity proves equivalence with negative type; closed interval and strict persistence prove the strict inequality between the suprema. No numerical eigensolver or extrapolation enters the proof.

originality.rationale: A bounded comparison with full primary text by Doust–Weston 2007, Li–Weston 2009, Caffarelli–Doust–Weston 2010, and Sánchez 2011, and searches of published mathematical research records found no theorem that states or implies the complete ten-triple leaf-balancing reversal without a new calculation. value.rationale: This is a natural fixed-size complete classification at the first perfectly equal three-hub positive leaf tuple (2,2,2), motivated by the balancing heuristic. Its unique middle-light asymmetric optimizer and strict exact threshold certificate refute simple extension of two-hub balancing behavior. The target invariant is the maximal all-scale Gaussian admissible distance power, not an arbitrary matrix statistic. The result is finite and sharply scoped, with no unproved all-order claims.
